content: शोभन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [शोभते शुभ्-ल्यु] .²1 Shining, splendid; <ls>Mb. 4. 42. 12</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> सुफलः शोभनभल्लिकः). .²2 Handsome, beautiful, lovely. .²3 Good, auspicious, fortunate. .²4 Richly decorated. .²5 Moral, virtuous. .²6 Correct, right. .{@-नः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²2 A planet. .²3 A burnt offering for the production of happy results. .{@-ना@} .²1 Turmeric. .²2 A beautiful or virtuous woman; तदिदं परिरक्ष शोभने भवितव्यप्रियसंगमं वपुः <ls>Ku. 4. 44</ls>. .²3 A sort of yellow pigment (= गोरोचना <ab>q. v.</ab>). .{@-नम्@} .²1 Beauty, lustre, brilliance. .²2 A lotus. .²3 An ornament. .²4 Virtue. .²5 Tin.
